main.description: A person's Local Network profile, in their own repo. Every account has at most one. A section is on when its object is present, even empty: the performer section makes the profile a DJ's, the promoter section a promoter's.

langs.description: The languages the profile's text is written in, like its bio.

takesInquiries.description: Whether promoters can send this DJ booking inquiries on Local Network. Off unless true, and only counts while the performer section is on.
